description: Office of the Public Service Commission - 4th Amendment - Medical Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Health Service
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to the Medical Service Minute of the Sri Lankan Health Service, which deals with public service recruitment, promotion qualifications, and administrative posts within the health service. It specifies recognized qualifications for promotion to Specialist Medical Officer/Dental Surgeon grades and adds new administrative posts in health-related ministries. This falls under Public Service Gazettes as it concerns public sector service conditions, recruitment, and administrative structures.
